properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
KATONDA lwe Lwazi lwaffe:
Ge maanyi-agataggwaawo-:
Tutya ki ffe bannannyini
Mukwano-ogwenkanaawo-?

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines:
Ensi nga tennatondebwa,
Ebintu nga mpaawo;
Edda n'edda ggwe-oba bumu,
Katonda-atavaawo.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Emyaka-olukumi gy'oli
Lwe lunaku lumu;
Gikulukuta ng'amazzi
Agayita-amangu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
N'ebintu byonna-eby'omu nsi
Biyita bwe bityo:
Leero tuba nabyo,naye
Jjo nga biweddewo.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Katonda lwe lwazi lwaffe,
Ge maanyi-agataggwaawo-;
Tugume ffe bannannyini
Mukwano-ogwenkanaawo-.
